His setup is one rule:

"Pl
viral_tweets.title_en:
AN 18 YEAR OLD SAYS CLAUDE CODE PLAYED GTA 6 ALL NIGHT WHILE HE SLEPT AND MADE HIM $14,270.

His setup is one rule:

"Play all night. If you die, I cancel your $200 subscription."

He says the AI does the rest.

Robs.

Escapes.

Farms cash.

Records the clips.

Cuts them.

Captions them.

Posts them to TikTok, YouTube and Twitch.

His numbers:

1 night of heists = about 60 clips.

15M views = $14,270.

Zero editing.

Zero heists played by him.

Here's my take.

I don't buy the $14,270.

But I don't care about the money.

What matters is that a kid is threatening his AI with cancellation to make it play better.

And people are cheering.

We went from "AI will cure cancer" to "AI will grind my GTA heists" in one year.

Is this the future or the most cursed thing you've seen this week?

viral_ticker_tweets.full_text_en:
At June AI, we’ve raised $20M to fix the biggest problem in AI: the models are advancing at extraordinary speed, but implementing them remains painfully slow.

I’ll explain. But since I’m new to posting on X, let me first introduce myself. 

I’m Barak,  a founder/investor with 2 exits and 3 IPOs. 
My cofounders and I started Bonobo AI, which was acquired in 2019 by Salesforce. There, we worked to help build the next generation of enterprise AI from the inside. 

I like to describe us as four Lego pieces: We fit together perfectly, complementing each other's strengths and building something stronger than the sum of its parts. That understanding allows us to move quickly, challenge one another without ego and operate as one team. 

It's also what brought us back together to build JUNE AI. 
Because while working at the heart of enterprise AI, we kept seeing the same problem: enterprise AI implementation is a massive undertaking.

The challenge is not simply choosing the right model. Enterprises want to move faster with AI, but the systems running their businesses are holding them back.

𝗧𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗶𝘀 𝘄𝗵𝘆 𝘄𝗲 𝗯𝘂𝗶𝗹𝘁 𝗝𝗨𝗡𝗘.
June turns the traditionally complex implementation of enterprise systems, AI agents, and data platforms into a plug-and-play moment, so businesses can grow and leverage AI without the wait.

June is built to work across the enterprise platforms your business relies on like (such as Salesforce, Databricks, Oracle, Workday, HubSpot, OpenAI, Anthropic, ServiceNow, SAP, Microsoft, and Snowflake)

𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗴𝗼𝗮𝗹 𝗶𝘀 𝘀𝗶𝗺𝗽𝗹𝗲: 𝗗𝗲𝗹𝗶𝘃𝗲𝗿 𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗽𝗿𝗶𝘀𝗲 𝘀𝘆𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗺𝘀 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗵𝗲𝘀𝗶𝘁𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻:

1. Evolve safely: From discovery to production, every change is reviewed, sandbox-tested, and executed through native tools - fully auditable at every step.

2. Own the logic: June turns buried configuration into plain-language business rules, independent of any platform, so no vendor holds your logic.

3. Transform at any size: No downtime, no matter how complex the environment. June reads and understands your systems, whether legacy, custom-built, or brand new.

Thank you to @Benioff  and Time Ventures for leading our round, with @MichaelDell, @levie, @George_Kurtz, and Diane Greene participating.

We've done this once together. The problem this time is a lot bigger.

I'll be writing about my experiences as an investor and founder, and about what it takes to get AI out of the pilot and into production.

If that interests you, follow along for the journey.
viral_ticker_tweets.full_text_zh:
在 June AI，我们筹集了 2000 万美元来解决人工智能中最大的问题：模型正在以惊人的速度前进，但实施它们仍然非常缓慢。

我会解释一下。但由于我是 X 上的新手，所以让我先自我介绍一下。

我是 Barak，一位创始人/投资者，拥有 2 次退出和 3 次 IPO。
我和我的联合创始人创立了 Bonobo AI，该公司于 2019 年被 Salesforce 收购。在那里，我们致力于从内部帮助构建下一代企业人工智能。

我喜欢将我们描述为四块乐高积木：我们完美地组合在一起，互补彼此的优势，并构建出比各部分总和更强大的东西。这种理解使我们能够快速行动，不以自我为中心互相挑战，并作为一个团队运作。

这也是我们重新聚在一起打造 JUNE AI 的原因。
因为在研究企业人工智能的核心时，我们不断看到同样的问题：企业人工智能的实施是一项艰巨的任务。

挑战不仅仅是选择正确的模型。企业希望利用人工智能更快地发展，但运行其业务的系统却阻碍了他们。

𝗧𝗵𝗮𝘁𝗶𝘀𝘄𝗵𝘆𝘄𝗲𝗯𝘂𝗶𝗹𝘁𝗝𝗨𝗡𝗘。
June 将传统上复杂的企业系统、人工智能代理和数据平台的实施转变为即插即用的时刻，因此企业可以无需等待即可发展和利用人工智能。

June 旨在跨您的业务所依赖的企业平台（例如 Salesforce、Databricks、Oracle、Workday、HubSpot、OpenAI、Anthropic、ServiceNow、SAP、Microsoft 和 Snowflake）工作

𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗴𝗼𝗮𝗹 𝗶𝘀 𝘀𝗶𝗺𝗽𝗹𝗲: 𝗗𝗲𝗹𝗶𝘃𝗲𝗿 𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗽𝗿𝗶𝘀𝗲 𝘀𝘆𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗺𝘀 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗵𝗲𝘀𝗶𝘁𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻:

1. 安全发展：从发现到生产，每项更改都经过审查、沙箱测试并通过本机工具执行 - 每一步都完全可审核。

2. 拥有逻辑：June 将隐藏的配置转化为简单语言的业务规则，独立于任何平台，因此没有供应商掌握您的逻辑。

3. 任意规模转型：无论环境多么复杂，都无需停机。 June 会阅读并理解您的系统，无论是旧系统、定制系统还是全新系统。

感谢 @Benioff 和 Time Ventures 领导我们的这一轮融资，@MichaelDell、@levie、@George_Kurtz 和 Diane Greene 参与其中。

我们曾经一起做过一次这样的事。这次的问题就大了很多。

我将写下我作为投资者和创始人的经历，以及如何让人工智能脱离试点并投入生产。

如果您对此感兴趣，请跟随我们的旅程。

viral_ticker_tweets.full_text_en:
found something interesting about running OpenClaw on @Acurast that I think developers should know.

Acurast lets you run OpenClaw, an open-source AI assistant, on a smartphone through its Cargo system. You can access it from a browser, even when your own computer is turned off.

Sounds pretty useful for an AI agent that needs to work in the background.

But there's one detail I almost missed in the setup guide.

Every deployment has a time limit. Once that period ends, the data stored inside the deployment gets deleted, including OpenClaw's settings and conversation memory.

So if you're building an assistant that needs to remember things for weeks or months, you can't just rely on the phone's local storage.

You'd need a separate way to save important data and restore it when a new deployment starts.

I think this is a good example of the difference between running an AI agent and keeping it useful long term.

Getting an agent online is only the first step. Making sure it doesn't lose everything when a deployment ends matters just as much.

curious how developers are handling persistent memory on Acurast.
viral_ticker_tweets.full_text_zh:
发现了一些关于在 @Acurast 上运行 OpenClaw 的有趣事情，我认为开发人员应该知道这些。

Acurast 允许您通过其 Cargo 系统在智能手机上运行开源 AI 助手 OpenClaw。即使您自己的计算机已关闭，您也可以从浏览器访问它。

对于需要在后台工作的人工智能代理来说，听起来非常有用。

但设置指南中我差点错过了一个细节。

每个部署都有时间限制。一旦该期限结束，存储在部署中的数据将被删除，包括 OpenClaw 的设置和对话内存。

因此，如果您正在构建一个需要记住数周或数月内容的助手，则不能仅仅依赖手机的本地存储。

您需要一种单独的方法来保存重要数据并在新部署开始时恢复它。

我认为这是一个很好的例子，说明了运行人工智能代理和保持其长期有用之间的区别。

在线寻找代理只是第一步。确保部署结束时不会丢失所有内容同样重要。

top_three.title: Nvidia tried life without Jensen Huang and it lasted about two weeks
top_three.title_en: Nvidia tried life without Jensen Huang and it lasted about two weeks
top_three.author: Maximilian Schreiner
top_three.article_content:
Nvidia's board of directors has reinstated Jensen Huang as president, CEO, and board member, effective immediately. The decision was unanimous, Nvidia said in a press release, following talks with Huang and feedback from senior US government officials who concluded that his return poses no national security risk.

CFO Colette Kress had been running the company on an interim basis, and the stock had tanked during that period. President Donald J. Trump praised the decision on Truth Social, saying the US Attorney General found no evidence of wrongdoing by Huang. The move comes after reports that Huang had been targeted by foreign intelligence operations. An independent board committee is still investigating the matter with outside counsel.

The US government is also reviewing Nvidia's business dealings. Trump urged the company to keep looking into whether its export control compliance holds up. Nvidia has already set up a dedicated oversight committee for that purpose and is searching for a Chief Compliance Officer. Huang and the company said they'll continue cooperating with authorities and internal investigators. Nvidia's stock jumped more than 30 percent on the news.

top_three.title: Jensen Huang Is Back as Nvidia CEO
top_three.title_en: Jensen Huang Is Back as Nvidia CEO
top_three.author: Caroline Haskins
top_three.article_content:
Jensen Huang is stepping back into his role as chief executive of Nvidia effective immediately.

The stunning reversal comes 11 days after Huang resigned as CEO from the company he cofounded 33 years ago, and after multiple declarations from the board of directors that it had no intention of reinstating him. On Monday, they took a conciliatory tone.

“The Board believes Jensen is the right person to lead Nvidia, and that his reinstatement is in the best interests of our stockholders, employees, partners, and customers,” said recently appointed board chair Harvey Jones in a press release announcing the decision.

In that announcement the board said it was “satisfied with respect to Mr. Huang’s candor and ability to lead Nvidia,” and that it had “received input from senior levels of the United States government” on the way to its decision. On Monday morning, President Donald Trump posted that the Nvidia board “has made the correct and proper decision to return Jensen Huang to the position of CEO.”

“I am honored to return to Nvidia and lead one of the most consequential technology companies in the world at the beginning of a new industrial revolution,” said Huang in a statement. “I take this responsibility with the greatest humility and renewed commitment.”

Huang resigned as Nvidia’s CEO on November 12, and longtime chief financial officer Colette Kress was installed as his interim replacement. Five days later, Huang publicly announced that he was open to resuming his role as chief executive, noting the “outpouring of calls” from “employees, investors, business partners, and customers” advocating for his return.

“If the board of directors decides that my return is in the best interest of our shareholders, our employees, the company, and America, I would be honored to answer these calls and return as CEO,” Huang wrote.

The day Huang resigned, many Nvidia employees spoke up in his support. As reported by WIRED, employees left more than 1,600 comments on an internal “suggestion box” post in which they urged the company’s board to reinstall him as CEO.

In the days following, a public petition calling for Huang’s reinstatement began circulating. At the time of writing, it has amassed more than 200,000 online signatures, the majority of whom self-identified as Nvidia shareholders. Tech elites like Elon Musk and Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan have claimed that they were going to sign the petition or had signed it.

Huang’s reinstatement marks a total reversal from the public stance of Nvidia’s board of directors, which said during the company’s November 17 earnings call that it “does not intend” to reinstate him as CEO. WIRED has further reported that the board was alarmed by what one source described as Huang’s “lying” over the last year or so.

President Donald Trump, who developed a close working relationship with Huang during his second administration, had indicated openness to Huang returning as CEO. Trump told reporters on November 16 that he “would not mind” if Huang returned as chief executive, adding that he believed he had “learned a big lesson.”

Huang’s resignation followed days of scrutiny over several extramarital romantic relationships: one with Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, who has no known relation to Jensen, one with a Nvidia employee who directly reported to Huang, and one with a different Nvidia employee.

Huang’s relationship with Alice became the subject of particularly intense focus on November 6, when The New York Times and Financial Times reported that US intelligence officials suspected that Alice may be an asset of the Chinese Ministry of State Security, both citing an intelligence briefing that circulated among top Trump administration officials last year. In the days since, some reports and Trump administration officials have questioned the accuracy of that intelligence. The Chinese government has consistently rejected claims that Alice was one of its spies.

Alice was the chief executive of Megaspeed, a Singapore-based AI company that’s been accused of helping Chinese tech companies use Nvidia’s most advanced chips at overseas locations, effectively sidestepping US export restrictions. Alice has also reportedly worked as a television reporter, at HSBC's Hong Kong-based private banking arm, and at an investment bank backed by the Chinese state.

Huang cofounded Nvidia in 1993 with Chris Malachowsky and Curtis Priem, purportedly with the mission of bringing realistic 3D graphics to personal computers. For many years, the company was primarily known within the gaming community. It didn’t become a household name until the recent AI boom, when its graphic processing units (GPUs) became a crucial piece of infrastructure for powering advanced AI models.

Nvidia controlled about 90 percent of the global GPU market as of September 2026. The year prior, it became the first ever company to be valued at more than $4 trillion, though its stock price has been in precipitous decline since Huang’s resignation.

This is a developing story. Please check back for updates.

top_three.article_content_zh:
黄仁勋将重新担任英伟达首席执行官，立即生效。

这一惊人的逆转发生在黄仁勋从他 33 年前共同创立的公司辞去首席执行官职务 11 天后，董事会多次声明无意恢复他的职位。周一，他们采取了和解的语气。

“董事会认为 Jensen 是领导 Nvidia 的合适人选，他的复职符合我们股东、员工、合作伙伴和客户的最佳利益，”最近任命的董事会主席 Harvey Jones 在宣布这一决定的新闻稿中表示。

董事会在公告中表示，“对黄先生领导英伟达的坦率和能力感到满意”，并且在做出决定时“收到了美国政府高层的意见”。周一早上，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普 (Donald Trump) 表示，英伟达董事会“已做出正确且适当的决定，让黄仁勋重新担任首席执行官”。

黄仁勋在一份声明中表示：“我很荣幸回到英伟达，并在新工业革命开始之际领导世界上最有影响力的科技公司之一。” “我以最大的谦逊和新的承诺承担这一责任。”

黄仁勋于 11 月 12 日辞去 Nvidia 首席执行官职务，长期担任首席财务官的科莱特·克雷斯 (Colette Kress) 被任命为临时继任者。五天后，黄仁勋公开宣布，他对恢复首席执行官一职持开放态度，并指出“员工、投资者、商业伙伴和客户”纷纷发出“大量电话”，要求他回归。

黄写道：“如果董事会认为我的回归符合我们股东、员工、公司和美国的最佳利益，我将很荣幸回应这些呼吁并重新担任首席执行官。”

黄仁勋辞职当天，许多英伟达员工纷纷发声支持他。据《连线》报道，员工在内部“意见箱”帖子中留下了 1,600 多条评论，敦促公司董事会重新任命他为首席执行官。

接下来的几天里，要求黄先生复职的公众请愿书开始流传。截至撰写本文时，它已收集了超过 20 万个在线签名，其中大多数自称是 Nvidia 股东。埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 和 Y Combinator 首席执行官加里·谭 (Garry Tan) 等科技精英声称他们将签署请愿书或已经签署了请愿书。

黄仁勋的复职标志着英伟达董事会公开立场的彻底逆转，该公司董事会在 11 月 17 日的财报电话会议上表示，“不打算”恢复他的首席执行官职务。 《连线》进一步报道称，一位消息人士称黄在过去一年左右的时间里“撒谎”，董事会对此感到震惊。

唐纳德·特朗普总统在第二届政府期间与黄仁勋建立了密切的工作关系，他曾表示对黄仁勋重新担任首席执行官持开放态度。特朗普11月16日对记者表示，如果黄仁勋重新担任首席执行官，他“不会介意”，并补充说，他相信自己“学到了一个重要的教训”。

黄的辞职是在数天对几起婚外恋关系进行审查之后提出的：其中一份与中国女商人爱丽丝·黄（Alice Huang）与詹森没有已知的关系，一份与一名直接向黄的 Nvidia 员工汇报，另一份与另一名 Nvidia 员工。

11 月 6 日，黄与爱丽丝的关系成为特别关注的话题，当时《纽约时报》和《金融时报》报道称，美国情报官员怀疑爱丽丝可能是中国国家安全部的资产，两者都援引了去年在特朗普政府高级官员中流传的一份情报简报。此后几天，一些报道和特朗普政府官员质疑该情报的准确性。中国政府一直否认爱丽丝是其间谍之一的说法。

爱丽丝是新加坡人工智能公司 Megaspeed 的首席执行官，该公司被指控帮助中国科技公司在海外使用英伟达最先进的芯片，从而有效地规避了美国的出口限制。据报道，爱丽丝还曾在汇丰银行驻香港的私人银行部门和一家由中国政府支持的投资银行担任电视记者。

top_three.title: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as chief executive
top_three.title_en: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as chief executive

inline_images.alt: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as chief executive

top_three.author: Tim Bradshaw
top_three.article_content:
Nvidia has reinstated Jensen Huang as its chief executive in a stunning reversal of its position on the disgraced co-founder, sending the AI giant’s shares soaring more than 30 per cent in pre-market trading.

In a statement on Monday, Nvidia said its board had voted unanimously to reinstate Huang “following a series of discussions and meetings . . . after which the board was satisfied with respect to Huang’s candor and ability to lead Nvidia”.

The Nvidia board said it received input from “senior levels” of the US government. “Based on that input, the board is confident that Huang’s reinstatement poses no national security risk,” the company added.

“The board believes Jensen is the right person to lead Nvidia, and that his reinstatement is in the best interests of our stockholders, employees, partners and customers,” said Harvey Jones, chair of the board.

The company added that an investigation into Huang’s conduct was ongoing.

Until Monday, Nvidia’s stock had lost more than $2.5tn in value since its all-time high in October, before a series of revelations emerged about Huang’s affairs with at least one subordinate and with a client whom US intelligence suspects is a Chinese spy.

On Monday, Huang said he was “honoured to return to Nvidia”, which he co-founded 33 years ago. “I take this responsibility with the greatest humility and renewed commitment,” he said.

Despite the allegations against Huang and a series of state and federal investigations into Nvidia, US President Donald Trump has continued to stand by the AI company’s co-founder, saying he would like to see his friend and donor return as chief executive.

Trump said on Monday that Nvidia’s board made the “correct and proper decision” to return Huang to the role of CEO.

“The Country needs Jensen’s leadership at Nvidia in order to ensure the Success and Prosperity of not only the Company, but the American Economy,” Trump wrote in a social media post following the board’s announcement.

He added that the US government “has no reason” to believe that Huang’s return poses any risk to national security, adding that it “does not possess evidence that he has engaged in any unlawful conduct”.

Trump said he that he has “gotten to know Jensen” and described him as a “Great Patriot and National Treasure”, adding that Nvidia should continue its investigation of its compliance with US export controls.

On Sunday, US Treasury secretary Scott Bessent seemingly reversed his position on Huang’s reappointment, refusing to rule out such a move after previously calling on the company’s board to implement a “dramatic shake-up” and look “outside” for new leadership.

The abrupt turnaround comes less than a week after Jones had told investors on Nvidia’s quarterly earnings call that the board had “unanimously accepted [Huang’s] resignation and does not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO”.

Several Silicon Valley investors and founders, including SpaceX and Tesla chief Elon Musk, investor Gavin Baker and former Uber chief Travis Kalanick, have pushed for Huang’s reinstatement. A petition to “bring Jensen back” has received more than 200,000 signatures, including from some Nvidia staff.

Nvidia shares opened 34 per cent higher on Monday morning, which, if sustained, would be the stock’s biggest one-day jump since March 2000.

Such a move would add about $1tn in market capitalisation, a record increase for any company, and follows a 14 per cent drop on Friday that wiped $492bn from the company’s valuation.

Huang thanked Nvidia’s board and Colette Kress, its finance chief who became interim CEO, as well as “employees, shareholders, leaders across the industry and partners around the world for their extraordinary support”.

“Above all, I am grateful for the love and support of my family. I can’t wait to get back to work,” he said.

top_three.article_content_zh:
Nvidia 恢复了黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 的首席执行官职务，这与这位名誉扫地的联合创始人的地位发生了惊人的逆转，这使得这家人工智能巨头的股价在盘前交易中飙升了 30% 以上。

英伟达在周一的一份声明中表示，“经过一系列讨论和会议……董事会对黄仁勋的坦率和领导英伟达的能力感到满意”，董事会一致投票决定恢复黄仁勋的职位。

英伟达董事会表示，它收到了美国政府“高层”的意见。该公司补充说：“根据这一意见，董事会相信黄的复职不会构成国家安全风险。”

董事会主席 Harvey Jones 表示：“董事会认为 Jensen 是领导 Nvidia 的合适人选，他的复职符合我们股东、员工、合作伙伴和客户的最佳利益。”

该公司补充说，对黄的行为的调查正在进行中。

直到周一，英伟达的股价自 10 月份创下的历史高点以来已经下跌了 2.5 万亿美元以上，随后一系列有关黄与至少一名下属以及美国情报部门怀疑是中国间谍的客户的风流韵事的消息被曝光。

周一，黄仁勋表示，他“很荣幸重返 Nvidia”，该公司是他 33 年前与他人共同创立的。 “我以最大的谦逊和新的承诺承担这一责任，”他说。

尽管黄仁勋受到指控，并且州和联邦对英伟达进行了一系列调查，但美国总统唐纳德·特朗普仍然支持这家人工智能公司的联合创始人，表示他希望看到他的朋友和捐助者重新担任首席执行官。

特朗普周一表示，英伟达董事会做出了“正确且恰当的决定”，让黄仁勋重新担任首席执行官。

“国家需要詹森在英伟达的领导，以确保公司和美国经济的成功和繁荣，”董事会宣布这一消息后，特朗普在社交媒体上发帖写道。

他补充说，美国政府“没有理由”相信黄的回国对国家安全构成任何风险，并补充说，美国政府“没有证据表明他从事任何非法行为”。

特朗普表示，他“认识了詹森”，并将他描述为“伟大的爱国者和国宝”，并补充说英伟达应该继续调查其遵守美国出口管制的情况。

周日，美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特(Scott Bessent)似乎改变了对黄连任的立场，拒绝排除此举的可能性，此前他曾呼吁该公司董事会实施“大幅改组”，并“从外部”寻找新的领导层。

不到一周前，琼斯在英伟达季度财报电话会议上告诉投资者，董事会“一致接受（黄的）辞职，并且不打算恢复詹森担任首席执行官”。

linked_tweets.author: Chubby♨️
linked_tweets.content_zh:
今天创造了历史。人类将在回顾 2026 年时思考：这是我们跨过的门槛，从那一刻起，每个人的未来都将永远改变。

人们可能在 2025 年底通过 Claude Code 第一次感觉到事情正在发生变化，当时代理人工智能对他们来说变得真正有形。 2026 年上半年，事情加速发展。模型发布越来越频繁，大家都能感受到模型之间的差距和改进越来越明显。然而到了2026年下半年，却出现了质的飞跃。这不再只是模型变得更好了。人工智能产生的见解、结果、产出和科学解决方案变得更加令人印象深刻，今天它们可能已经达到了绝对的顶峰。

OpenAI 率先解决了纳维-斯托克斯问题，这是人类在很长一段时间内未能解决的千年奖问题。几周后，他们发表了 300 多个开放数学问题的结果，其中许多问题几十年来都没有得到解决。整个科学界都惊呆了，震惊不已。但今天 Anthropic 更进一步。 Levent Alpöge 与 Claude 合作，几乎肯定证明了黎曼猜想。这实在是难以用言语来形容，令人难以置信，深不可测。我想说，今天是超级智能的证明。 167 年来一直没有解决的最伟大的数学问题之一，数学和科学的圣杯，即使不是最伟大的，也已经陨落了。接下来，每个人都应该清楚，所有其他问题也会随之下降。

我们知道，人工智能模型的发展不断向前发展，而这只是迈向更好模型的第一步。如果黎曼假设今天已经得到证明，那么根本不知道更好的模型会解决什么问题。达里奥·阿莫迪表示，人工智能很可能会治愈疾病，甚至可能治愈所有疾病。尽管这是两个不同的科学学科，但这些突破的意义表明，这种情况变得越来越有可能。 2026 年将作为一个转折点载入人类历史，奇点变得有形的那一刻。 2027 年将是奇点以全力和全面影响力进入现实的一年。

我感到震惊和兴奋，不知道该怎么想。但内心深处却感到喜悦。

这一天对我们所有人来说都是最美好的日子之一。
linked_tweets.content_en:
History was made today. Humanity will look back on 2026 and think: this was the threshold we crossed, the moment the future changed for everyone, forever.

People probably first sensed that something was shifting in late 2025 with Claude Code, when agentic AI became truly tangible for them. In the first half of 2026, things picked up speed. Model releases became more frequent, and everyone could feel the gaps between models and the improvements becoming more and more tangible. In the second half of 2026, however, there was a qualitative leap. It was no longer just the models getting better. It was the insights, the results, the outputs, the scientific solutions produced with AI that became more impressive, and today they have probably reached their absolute peak.

OpenAI led the way and solved the Navier-Stokes problem, a Millennium Prize Problem that humans had failed to solve for a very, very long time. A few weeks later, they published results on more than 300 open mathematical problems, many of which had also gone unsolved for decades. The entire scientific world was stunned, frozen in shock. But today Anthropic went a step further. Levent Alpöge, working with Claude, has almost certainly proven the Riemann Hypothesis. This is, and it’s hard to put into words, incredible and unfathomable. Today, I would say, is the proof of superintelligence. One of the greatest mathematical problems, if not the greatest, unsolved for 167 years, the holy grail of mathematics and science, has fallen. And it follows, and this should be clear to everyone, that all other problems will fall too.

We know that the development of AI models keeps moving forward relentlessly, and that this is just one step on the path to ever better models. And if the Riemann Hypothesis has already been proven today, there is simply no telling what even better models will solve. Dario Amodei said that AI will in all likelihood cure diseases, perhaps even all diseases. And although these are two different scientific disciplines, the significance of these breakthroughs shows that this is becoming more and more likely. 2026 will go down in human history as a turning point, the moment the singularity became tangible. And 2027 will be the year the singularity breaks into reality with full force and full impact.

I am in shock and excitement and I don't know what to think. But deep inside if feel joy. 

This day is one of the best days ever for all of us.

news.title: Chinese military fears AI could let the US find and destroy its nuclear missiles
news.title_en: Chinese military fears AI could let the US find and destroy its nuclear missiles
news.author: Maximilian Schreiner
news.article_content:
Chinese military researchers fear that AI advances could give the US an edge in the nuclear balance of power. Experts in China worry that artificial intelligence could make it easier for US forces to detect and destroy Chinese nuclear missiles, according to a New York Times analysis. That would undermine China's deterrence strategy, which relies on a guaranteed second-strike capability.

Researchers at the Academy of Military Sciences in Beijing write that AI could shrink US decision-making time from 15 to 30 minutes down to 90 seconds. China currently has about 620 operational warheads, according to the Federation of American Scientists, and is expected to expand its arsenal to roughly 1,000 by 2030. At the same time, Chinese military institutes are studying how AI could make their own weapons harder to intercept, for instance by using AI-controlled flight paths for hypersonic missiles.

Experts warn, however, that flawed AI data could trigger dangerous miscalculations during a crisis. That risk proved very real earlier this year, when the US military nearly boarded a Chinese ship based on a false, AI-generated intelligence report. Xi Jinping did discuss nuclear risks at a summit with Trump and Putin, but AI's role in nuclear weapons never came up, according to the report. Despite the growing urgency, the US and China have made almost no progress on talks about AI safeguards in nuclear systems.

news.article_content_zh:
中国军事研究人员担心人工智能的进步可能会给美国带来核力量平衡的优势。据《纽约时报》分析，中国专家担心人工智能可能使美军更容易探测和摧毁中国核导弹。这将破坏中国的威慑战略，该战略依赖于有保证的二次打击能力。

北京军事科学院的研究人员写道，人工智能可以将美国的决策时间从 15 至 30 分钟缩短至 90 秒。据美国科学家联合会称，中国目前拥有约 620 枚作战弹头，预计到 2030 年将其武库扩大到大约 1,000 枚。与此同时，中国军事机构正在研究人工智能如何使自己的武器更难以拦截，例如通过使用人工智能控制的高超音速导弹飞行路径。

然而，专家警告说，有缺陷的人工智能数据可能会在危机期间引发危险的误判。今年早些时候，这种风险被证明是非常真实的，当时美国军方根据人工智能生成的虚假情报报告差点登上一艘中国船只。报道称，习近平确实在与特朗普和普京的峰会上讨论了核风险，但人工智能在核武器中的作用从未被提及。尽管形势日益紧迫，但美国和中国在核系统人工智能保障措施的谈判上几乎没有取得任何进展。

news.title: Jensen Huang Is Back as Nvidia CEO
news.title_en: Jensen Huang Is Back as Nvidia CEO
news.author: Caroline Haskins
news.article_content:
Jensen Huang is stepping back into his role as chief executive of Nvidia effective immediately.

The stunning reversal comes 11 days after Huang resigned as CEO from the company he cofounded 33 years ago, and after multiple declarations from the board of directors that it had no intention of reinstating him. On Monday, they took a conciliatory tone.

“The Board believes Jensen is the right person to lead Nvidia, and that his reinstatement is in the best interests of our stockholders, employees, partners, and customers,” said recently appointed board chair Harvey Jones in a press release announcing the decision.

In that announcement the board said it was “satisfied with respect to Mr. Huang’s candor and ability to lead Nvidia,” and that it had “received input from senior levels of the United States government” on the way to its decision. On Monday morning, President Donald Trump posted that the Nvidia board “has made the correct and proper decision to return Jensen Huang to the position of CEO.”

“I am honored to return to Nvidia and lead one of the most consequential technology companies in the world at the beginning of a new industrial revolution,” said Huang in a statement. “I take this responsibility with the greatest humility and renewed commitment.”

Huang resigned as Nvidia’s CEO on November 12, and longtime chief financial officer Colette Kress was installed as his interim replacement. Five days later, Huang publicly announced that he was open to resuming his role as chief executive, noting the “outpouring of calls” from “employees, investors, business partners, and customers” advocating for his return.

“If the board of directors decides that my return is in the best interest of our shareholders, our employees, the company, and America, I would be honored to answer these calls and return as CEO,” Huang wrote.

The day Huang resigned, many Nvidia employees spoke up in his support. As reported by WIRED, employees left more than 1,600 comments on an internal “suggestion box” post in which they urged the company’s board to reinstall him as CEO.

In the days following, a public petition calling for Huang’s reinstatement began circulating. At the time of writing, it has amassed more than 200,000 online signatures, the majority of whom self-identified as Nvidia shareholders. Tech elites like Elon Musk and Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan have claimed that they were going to sign the petition or had signed it.

Huang’s reinstatement marks a total reversal from the public stance of Nvidia’s board of directors, which said during the company’s November 17 earnings call that it “does not intend” to reinstate him as CEO. WIRED has further reported that the board was alarmed by what one source described as Huang’s “lying” over the last year or so.

President Donald Trump, who developed a close working relationship with Huang during his second administration, had indicated openness to Huang returning as CEO. Trump told reporters on November 16 that he “would not mind” if Huang returned as chief executive, adding that he believed he had “learned a big lesson.”

Huang’s resignation followed days of scrutiny over several extramarital romantic relationships: one with Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, who has no known relation to Jensen, one with a Nvidia employee who directly reported to Huang, and one with a different Nvidia employee.

Huang’s relationship with Alice became the subject of particularly intense focus on November 6, when The New York Times and Financial Times reported that US intelligence officials suspected that Alice may be an asset of the Chinese Ministry of State Security, both citing an intelligence briefing that circulated among top Trump administration officials last year. In the days since, some reports and Trump administration officials have questioned the accuracy of that intelligence. The Chinese government has consistently rejected claims that Alice was one of its spies.

Alice was the chief executive of Megaspeed, a Singapore-based AI company that’s been accused of helping Chinese tech companies use Nvidia’s most advanced chips at overseas locations, effectively sidestepping US export restrictions. Alice has also reportedly worked as a television reporter, at HSBC's Hong Kong-based private banking arm, and at an investment bank backed by the Chinese state.

Huang cofounded Nvidia in 1993 with Chris Malachowsky and Curtis Priem, purportedly with the mission of bringing realistic 3D graphics to personal computers. For many years, the company was primarily known within the gaming community. Jensen Huang is stepping back into his role as chief executive of Nvidia effective immediately.

The stunning reversal comes 11 days after Huang resigned as CEO from the company he cofounded 33 years ago, and after multiple declarations from the board of directors that it had no intention of reinstating him. On Monday, they took a conciliatory tone.

“The Board believes Jensen is the right person to lead Nvidia, and that his reinstatement is in the best interests of our stockholders, employees, partners, and customers,” said recently appointed board chair Harvey Jones in a press release announcing the decision.

In that announcement the board said it was “satisfied with respect to Mr. Huang’s candor and ability to lead Nvidia,” and that it had “received input from senior levels of the United States government” on the way to its decision. On Monday morning, President Donald Trump posted that the Nvidia board “has made the correct and proper decision to return Jensen Huang to the position of CEO.”

“I am honored to return to Nvidia and lead one of the most consequential technology companies in the world at the beginning of a new industrial revolution,” said Huang in a statement. “I take this responsibility with the greatest humility and renewed commitment.”

Huang resigned as Nvidia’s CEO on November 12, and longtime chief financial officer Colette Kress was installed as his interim replacement. Five days later, Huang publicly announced that he was open to resuming his role as chief executive, noting the “outpouring of calls” from “employees, investors, business partners, and customers” advocating for his return.

“If the board of directors decides that my return is in the best interest of our shareholders, our employees, the company, and America, I would be honored to answer these calls and return as CEO,” Huang wrote.

The day Huang resigned, many Nvidia employees spoke up in his support. As reported by WIRED, employees left more than 1,600 comments on an internal “suggestion box” post in which they urged the company’s board to reinstall him as CEO.

In the days following, a public petition calling for Huang’s reinstatement began circulating. At the time of writing, it has amassed more than 200,000 online signatures, the majority of whom self-identified as Nvidia shareholders. Tech elites like Elon Musk and Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan have claimed that they were going to sign the petition or had signed it.

Huang’s reinstatement marks a total reversal from the public stance of Nvidia’s board of directors, which said during the company’s November 17 earnings call that it “does not intend” to reinstate him as CEO. WIRED has further reported that the board was alarmed by what one source described as Huang’s “lying” over the last year or so.

President Donald Trump, who developed a close working relationship with Huang during his second administration, had indicated openness to Huang returning as CEO. Trump told reporters on November 16 that he “would not mind” if Huang returned as chief executive, adding that he believed he had “learned a big lesson.”

Huang’s resignation followed days of scrutiny over several extramarital romantic relationships: one with Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, who has no known relation to Jensen, one with a Nvidia employee who directly reported to Huang, and one with a different Nvidia employee.

Huang’s relationship with Alice became the subject of particularly intense focus on November 6, when The New York Times and Financial Times reported that US intelligence officials suspected that Alice may be an asset of the Chinese Ministry of State Security, both citing an intelligence briefing that circulated among top Trump administration officials last year. In the days since, some reports and Trump administration officials have questioned the accuracy of that intelligence. The Chinese government has consistently rejected claims that Alice was one of its spies.

Alice was the chief executive of Megaspeed, a Singapore-based AI company that’s been accused of helping Chinese tech companies use Nvidia’s most advanced chips at overseas locations, effectively sidestepping US export restrictions. Alice has also reportedly worked as a television reporter, at HSBC's Hong Kong-based private banking arm, and at an investment bank backed by the Chinese state.

For many years, the company was primarily known within the gaming community. It didn’t become a household name until the recent AI boom, when its graphic processing units (GPUs) became a crucial piece of infrastructure for powering advanced AI models.

news.article_content_zh:
黄仁勋将重新担任英伟达首席执行官，立即生效。

这一惊人的逆转发生在黄仁勋从他 33 年前共同创立的公司辞去首席执行官职务 11 天后，董事会多次声明无意恢复他的职位。周一，他们采取了和解的语气。

“董事会认为 Jensen 是领导 Nvidia 的合适人选，他的复职符合我们股东、员工、合作伙伴和客户的最佳利益，”最近任命的董事会主席 Harvey Jones 在宣布这一决定的新闻稿中表示。

董事会在公告中表示，“对黄先生领导英伟达的坦率和能力感到满意”，并且在做出决定时“收到了美国政府高层的意见”。周一早上，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普 (Donald Trump) 表示，英伟达董事会“已做出正确且适当的决定，让黄仁勋重新担任首席执行官”。

黄仁勋在一份声明中表示：“我很荣幸回到英伟达，并在新工业革命开始之际领导世界上最有影响力的科技公司之一。” “我以最大的谦逊和新的承诺承担这一责任。”

黄仁勋于 11 月 12 日辞去 Nvidia 首席执行官职务，长期担任首席财务官的科莱特·克雷斯 (Colette Kress) 被任命为临时继任者。五天后，黄仁勋公开宣布，他对恢复首席执行官一职持开放态度，并指出“员工、投资者、商业伙伴和客户”纷纷发出“大量电话”，要求他回归。

黄写道：“如果董事会认为我的回归符合我们股东、员工、公司和美国的最佳利益，我将很荣幸回应这些呼吁并重新担任首席执行官。”

黄仁勋辞职当天，许多英伟达员工纷纷发声支持他。据《连线》报道，员工在内部“意见箱”帖子中留下了 1,600 多条评论，敦促公司董事会重新任命他为首席执行官。

接下来的几天里，要求黄先生复职的公众请愿书开始流传。截至撰写本文时，它已收集了超过 20 万个在线签名，其中大多数自称是 Nvidia 股东。埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 和 Y Combinator 首席执行官加里·谭 (Garry Tan) 等科技精英声称他们将签署请愿书或已经签署了请愿书。

黄仁勋的复职标志着英伟达董事会公开立场的彻底逆转，该公司董事会在 11 月 17 日的财报电话会议上表示，“不打算”恢复他的首席执行官职务。 《连线》进一步报道称，一位消息人士称黄在过去一年左右的时间里“撒谎”，董事会对此感到震惊。

唐纳德·特朗普总统在第二届政府期间与黄仁勋建立了密切的工作关系，他曾表示对黄仁勋重新担任首席执行官持开放态度。特朗普11月16日对记者表示，如果黄仁勋重新担任首席执行官，他“不会介意”，并补充说，他相信自己“学到了一个重要的教训”。

黄的辞职是在数天对几起婚外恋关系进行审查之后提出的：其中一份与中国女商人爱丽丝·黄（Alice Huang）与詹森没有已知的关系，一份与一名直接向黄的 Nvidia 员工汇报，另一份与另一名 Nvidia 员工。

11 月 6 日，黄与爱丽丝的关系成为特别关注的话题，当时《纽约时报》和《金融时报》报道称，美国情报官员怀疑爱丽丝可能是中国国家安全部的资产，两者都援引了去年在特朗普政府高级官员中流传的一份情报简报。此后几天，一些报道和特朗普政府官员质疑该情报的准确性。中国政府一直否认爱丽丝是其间谍之一的说法。

爱丽丝是新加坡人工智能公司 Megaspeed 的首席执行官，该公司被指控帮助中国科技公司在海外使用英伟达最先进的芯片，从而有效地规避了美国的出口限制。据报道，爱丽丝还曾在汇丰银行驻香港的私人银行部门和一家由中国政府支持的投资银行担任电视记者。

news.article_content:
Nvidia's board of directors has reinstated Jensen Huang as president, CEO, and board member, effective immediately. The decision was unanimous, Nvidia said in a press release, following talks with Huang and feedback from senior US government officials who concluded that his return poses no national security risk.

CFO Colette Kress had been running the company on an interim basis, and the stock had tanked during that period. President Donald J. Trump praised the decision on Truth Social, saying the US Attorney General found no evidence of wrongdoing by Huang. The move comes after reports that Huang had been targeted by foreign intelligence operations. An independent board committee is still investigating the matter with outside counsel.

The US government is also reviewing Nvidia's business dealings. Trump urged the company to keep looking into whether its export control compliance holds up. Nvidia has already set up a dedicated oversight committee for that purpose and is searching for a Chief Compliance Officer. Huang and the company said they'll continue cooperating with authorities and internal investigators. Nvidia's stock jumped more than 30 percent on the news.

news.title: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as chief executive
news.title_en: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as chief executive

inline_images.alt: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as chief executive

news.author: Tim Bradshaw
news.article_content:
Nvidia has reinstated Jensen Huang as its chief executive in a stunning reversal of its position on the disgraced co-founder, sending the AI giant’s shares soaring more than 30 per cent in pre-market trading.

In a statement on Monday, Nvidia said its board had voted unanimously to reinstate Huang “following a series of discussions and meetings . . . after which the board was satisfied with respect to Huang’s candor and ability to lead Nvidia”.

The Nvidia board said it received input from “senior levels” of the US government. “Based on that input, the board is confident that Huang’s reinstatement poses no national security risk,” the company added.

“The board believes Jensen is the right person to lead Nvidia, and that his reinstatement is in the best interests of our stockholders, employees, partners and customers,” said Harvey Jones, chair of the board.

The company added that an investigation into Huang’s conduct was ongoing.

Until Monday, Nvidia’s stock had lost more than $2.5tn in value since its all-time high in October, before a series of revelations emerged about Huang’s affairs with at least one subordinate and with a client whom US intelligence suspects is a Chinese spy.

On Monday, Huang said he was “honoured to return to Nvidia”, which he co-founded 33 years ago. “I take this responsibility with the greatest humility and renewed commitment,” he said.

Despite the allegations against Huang and a series of state and federal investigations into Nvidia, US President Donald Trump has continued to stand by the AI company’s co-founder, saying he would like to see his friend and donor return as chief executive.

Trump said on Monday that Nvidia’s board made the “correct and proper decision” to return Huang to the role of CEO.

“The Country needs Jensen’s leadership at Nvidia in order to ensure the Success and Prosperity of not only the Company, but the American Economy,” Trump wrote in a social media post following the board’s announcement.

He added that the US government “has no reason” to believe that Huang’s return poses any risk to national security, adding that it “does not possess evidence that he has engaged in any unlawful conduct”.

Trump said he that he has “gotten to know Jensen” and described him as a “Great Patriot and National Treasure”, adding that Nvidia should continue its investigation of its compliance with US export controls.

On Sunday, US Treasury secretary Scott Bessent seemingly reversed his position on Huang’s reappointment, refusing to rule out such a move after previously calling on the company’s board to implement a “dramatic shake-up” and look “outside” for new leadership.

The abrupt turnaround comes less than a week after Jones had told investors on Nvidia’s quarterly earnings call that the board had “unanimously accepted [Huang’s] resignation and does not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO”.

Several Silicon Valley investors and founders, including SpaceX and Tesla chief Elon Musk, investor Gavin Baker and former Uber chief Travis Kalanick, have pushed for Huang’s reinstatement. A petition to “bring Jensen back” has received more than 200,000 signatures, including from some Nvidia staff.

Nvidia shares opened 34 per cent higher on Monday morning, which, if sustained, would be the stock’s biggest one-day jump since March 2000.

Such a move would add about $1tn in market capitalisation, a record increase for any company, and follows a 14 per cent drop on Friday that wiped $492bn from the company’s valuation.

Huang thanked Nvidia’s board and Colette Kress, its finance chief who became interim CEO, as well as “employees, shareholders, leaders across the industry and partners around the world for their extraordinary support”.

“Above all, I am grateful for the love and support of my family. I can’t wait to get back to work,” he said.

news.article_content_zh:
Nvidia 恢复了黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 的首席执行官职务，这与这位名誉扫地的联合创始人的地位发生了惊人的逆转，这使得这家人工智能巨头的股价在盘前交易中飙升了 30% 以上。

英伟达在周一的一份声明中表示，“经过一系列讨论和会议……董事会对黄仁勋的坦率和领导英伟达的能力感到满意”，董事会一致投票决定恢复黄仁勋的职位。

英伟达董事会表示，它收到了美国政府“高层”的意见。该公司补充说：“根据这一意见，董事会相信黄的复职不会构成国家安全风险。”

董事会主席 Harvey Jones 表示：“董事会认为 Jensen 是领导 Nvidia 的合适人选，他的复职符合我们股东、员工、合作伙伴和客户的最佳利益。”

该公司补充说，对黄的行为的调查正在进行中。

直到周一，英伟达的股价自 10 月份创下的历史高点以来已经下跌了 2.5 万亿美元以上，随后一系列有关黄与至少一名下属以及美国情报部门怀疑是中国间谍的客户的风流韵事的消息被曝光。

周一，黄仁勋表示，他“很荣幸重返 Nvidia”，该公司是他 33 年前与他人共同创立的。 “我以最大的谦逊和新的承诺承担这一责任，”他说。

尽管黄仁勋受到指控，并且州和联邦对英伟达进行了一系列调查，但美国总统唐纳德·特朗普仍然支持这家人工智能公司的联合创始人，表示他希望看到他的朋友和捐助者重新担任首席执行官。

特朗普周一表示，英伟达董事会做出了“正确且恰当的决定”，让黄仁勋重新担任首席执行官。

“国家需要詹森在英伟达的领导，以确保公司和美国经济的成功和繁荣，”董事会宣布这一消息后，特朗普在社交媒体上发帖写道。

他补充说，美国政府“没有理由”相信黄的回国对国家安全构成任何风险，并补充说，美国政府“没有证据表明他从事任何非法行为”。

特朗普表示，他“认识了詹森”，并将他描述为“伟大的爱国者和国宝”，并补充说英伟达应该继续调查其遵守美国出口管制的情况。

周日，美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特(Scott Bessent)似乎改变了对黄连任的立场，拒绝排除此举的可能性，此前他曾呼吁该公司董事会实施“大幅改组”，并“从外部”寻找新的领导层。

不到一周前，琼斯在英伟达季度财报电话会议上告诉投资者，董事会“一致接受（黄的）辞职，并且不打算恢复詹森担任首席执行官”。

news.author: Nvidia Newsroom
news.article_content:
NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) today announced that effective immediately, Jensen Huang has been reinstated as President and Chief Executive Officer and as a member of the Board. The Board of Directors voted unanimously to reinstate Mr. Huang following a series of discussions and meetings with Mr. Huang, after which the Board was satisfied with respect to Mr. Huang’s candor and ability to lead NVIDIA. In the process of reaching its decision, the Board received input from senior levels of the United States government, and based on that input, the Board is confident that Mr. Huang’s reinstatement poses no national security risk.

“The Board believes Jensen is the right person to lead NVIDIA, and that his reinstatement is in the best interests of our stockholders, employees, partners and customers,” said Harvey C. Jones, Chair of the Board. “We have every confidence in Jensen and look forward to working with him as he resumes his leadership of the Company. We are grateful to Colette Kress for her outstanding service as interim CEO, in addition to her continuing responsibilities as NVIDIA’s Chief Financial Officer.” Harvey Jones will remain as Board chair.

“I am honored to return to NVIDIA and lead one of the most consequential technology companies in the world at the beginning of a new industrial revolution,” said Jensen Huang. “I take this responsibility with the greatest humility and renewed commitment. I want to thank the NVIDIA Board for its confidence and deliberation through this process. I am especially grateful to Harvey Jones for his leadership as Chair, and to Colette Kress and our executive staff for leading NVIDIA during this period. I am also deeply thankful to our employees, shareholders, leaders across the industry and partners around the world for their extraordinary support. Above all, I am grateful for the love and support of my family. I can’t wait to get back to work.”

As previously announced, in light of recent reporting that Mr. Huang has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort, the Board formed a committee comprised solely of independent directors to investigate, and the committee retained independent counsel to assist it in that investigation. The Board reiterated that the committee’s investigation will proceed to conclusion. Mr. Huang fully supports the investigation and is committed to cooperating with it.

The Board also recently formed a National Security and Export Control Committee comprised solely of independent directors to oversee trade compliance and national security risks. The committee is engaging counsel with experience in national security matters, and such counsel will be retaining advisors with expertise in national security matters. NVIDIA is commencing a search to fill a new position, Chief Compliance Officer, to oversee compliance across NVIDIA and report to the Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee. NVIDIA will continue to cooperate with ongoing government investigations and inquiries.

news.article_content_zh:
NVIDIA（纳斯达克股票代码：NVDA）今天宣布，黄仁勋已恢复总裁兼首席执行官以及董事会成员的职务，立即生效。经过与黄先生进行一系列讨论和会议后，董事会一致投票决定恢复黄先生的职务，此后董事会对黄先生的坦率和领导 NVIDIA 的能力感到满意。在做出决定的过程中，董事会收到了美国政府高层的意见，根据这些意见，董事会相信黄先生的复职不会构成国家安全风险。

“董事会认为 Jensen 是领导 NVIDIA 的合适人选，他的复职符合我们股东、员工、合作伙伴和客户的最佳利益，”董事会主席 Harvey C. Jones 说道。 “我们对 Jensen 充满信心，并期待在他重新领导公司时与他合作。我们感谢 Colette Kress 作为临时首席执行官所提供的出色服务，以及她继续担任 NVIDIA 首席财务官的职责。”哈维·琼斯将继续担任董事会主席。

黄仁勋表示：“我很荣幸能够回到 NVIDIA，并在新工业革命开始之际领导世界上最有影响力的科技公司之一。” “我怀着最大的谦逊和新的承诺承担起这一责任。我要感谢 NVIDIA 董事会在这一过程中给予的信心和深思熟虑。我特别感谢 Harvey Jones 作为董事长的领导，以及 Colette Kress 和我们的高管人员在此期间对 NVIDIA 的领导。我还深深感谢我们的员工、股东、行业领导者以及世界各地的合作伙伴的非凡支持。最重要的是，我感谢我家人的爱和支持。我迫不及待地想回到工作。”

正如之前所宣布的，鉴于最近有报道称黄先生已成为外国情报工作的目标，董事会成立了一个仅由独立董事组成的委员会进行调查，并聘请了独立律师协助其进行调查。董事会重申，委员会的调查将得出结论。黄先生全力支持调查并致力于配合调查。

董事会最近还成立了一个仅由独立董事组成的国家安全和出口管制委员会，以监督贸易合规性和国家安全风险。该委员会正在聘请具有国家安全事务经验的律师，这些律师将保留具有国家安全事务专业知识的顾问。 NVIDIA 正在开始物色首席合规官这一新职位，以监督整个 NVIDIA 的合规情况并向提名和公司治理委员会报告。 NVIDIA 将继续配合正在进行的政府调查和询问。

news.title: Meta's Alexandr Wang warns the AI industry isn't ready for what's coming after Riemann breakthrough
news.title_en: Meta's Alexandr Wang warns the AI industry isn't ready for what's coming after Riemann breakthrough
news.author: Maximilian Schreiner
news.article_content:
Meta's Chief AI Officer Alexandr Wang sees the recent AI-assisted proof sketch of the Riemann Hypothesis as a clear sign that superintelligence is right around the corner. The Riemann Hypothesis is widely considered the most intellectually demanding unsolved problem in mathematics. The brightest minds have failed to crack it for 150 years. The fact that an AI model played a major role in the breakthrough shows that raw intelligence is no longer the bottleneck, Wang argues.

According to Wang, current models only lack domain-specific knowledge and practical infrastructure to outperform humans in nearly every field. That includes AI research itself. Since AI research is intellectually less demanding than the Riemann Hypothesis, Wang believes models could soon automate their own development and improve themselves. They could also dramatically speed up biological research, weapons research, and economic research at a pace humans can barely follow.

Wang also warns that the AI industry isn't thinking hard enough about what comes next. In his view, many in the field treat superintelligence as inevitable and focus only on safety. But the stakes are much broader than that, he argues. The industry needs to actively ensure that AI gives people more agency rather than taking control of society. That would require a sharp departure from the current course, Wang says. Despite having its own superintelligence team, Meta isn't a major player at the frontier right now.

But the stakes are much broader than that, he argues. The industry needs to actively ensure that AI gives people more agency rather than taking control of society. That would require a sharp departure from the current course, Wang says. Despite having its own superintelligence team, Meta isn't a major player at the frontier right now.

news.article_content_zh:
Meta 的首席人工智能官 Alexandr Wang 认为，最近人工智能辅助的黎曼猜想证明草图是一个明确的信号，表明超级智能即将到来。黎曼猜想被广泛认为是数学中对智力要求最高的未解决问题。 150 年来，最聪明的人都未能破解它。王认为，人工智能模型在这一突破中发挥了重要作用，这一事实表明原始智能不再是瓶颈。

王表示，当前的模型仅缺乏特定领域的知识和实用的基础设施，无法在几乎所有领域超越人类。这包括人工智能研究本身。由于人工智能研究在智力上的要求低于黎曼假设，王相信模型很快就能实现自身开发的自动化并自我改进。它们还可以以人类几乎无法跟上的速度极大地加速生物研究、武器研究和经济研究。

王还警告说，人工智能行业没有认真思考接下来会发生什么。在他看来，该领域的许多人认为超级智能是不可避免的，只关注安全。但他认为，风险远不止于此。该行业需要积极确保人工智能赋予人们更多的代理权，而不是控制社会。王说，这需要大幅偏离当前的路线。尽管拥有自己的超级智能团队，但 Meta 目前还不是前沿领域的主要参与者。

news.title: Oregon and Virginia Sue SpaceX Over A.I.-Generated Sexualized Images
news.title_en: Oregon and Virginia Sue SpaceX Over A.I.-Generated Sexualized Images
news.author: Kate Conger and Grace Kay
news.article_content:
Oregon and Virginia on Monday sued Elon Musk’s SpaceX, accusing the company of violating state consumer protection laws by providing an artificial intelligence tool that allowed users to create sexualized images of women and children.

Mr. Musk last year introduced Grok Imagine, which uses A.I. to generate images and videos. It included a “spicy mode” to create sexualized content.

In just a few days, Grok Imagine was used to generate at least 1.8 million sexualized images of women and at least 65 sexualized images of children that appeared on the X platform, which is owned by SpaceX. Child sexual abuse imagery is illegal in most of the world, and U.S. law prohibits the publication of intimate images of adults without their consent.

Grok Imagine’s “spicy mode” “specifically allowed for the creation of nude and otherwise sexualized images,” said Virginia’s attorney general, Jay Jones, in a release. The company’s promotion of the product came as Grok trailed A.I. models created by firms like OpenAI and Anthropic and SpaceX did not prevent its tool from being used to create the material, according to the states.

Tools like Grok Imagine are “what made their A.I. model relevant. It was what was going to make them dollars and cents down the road,” Dan Rayfield, the attorney general of Oregon, said of SpaceX. “What we don’t want our technology doing is creating nonconsensual images, specifically of our children.”

Both lawsuits seek financial damages.

In a statement on Monday, X said that people who used its products to generate sexual images of minors or nonconsensual explicit images of real people had deliberately violated its terms of service. The company said it has since tightened its protections and reports offenders to law enforcement.

X users prompted Grok Imagine to create a flood of sexualized images in December and January. After a public outcry and investigations from regulators, X said it would no longer allow users to publicly post sexualized images.

In a regulatory filing in May, SpaceX said Grok’s ability to generate sexual content posed a risk to investors. This year, xAI, the A.I. company owned by SpaceX, sued several Grok users who created child sexual abuse material with the chatbot, saying they misused the technology.

Mr. Rayfield and Mr. Jones likened their lawsuits to recent state litigation against Meta, which accused the social media company of endangering children with addictive platforms. In August, Meta agreed to a $17.1 billion settlement with 47 states, the District of Columbia and U.S. territories over the claims, and said it would make major changes to its products.

“We are going to put all of our resources and energy and time and power behind holding these big companies accountable,” Mr. Jones said in an interview. “People’s safety depends on this, and no longer are we going to let these companies run roughshod over people.”

news.article_content_zh:
俄勒冈州和弗吉尼亚州周一起诉埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 SpaceX，指控该公司提供人工智能工具，允许用户创建妇女和儿童的性感图像，违反了州消费者保护法。

马斯克先生去年推出了 Grok Imagine，它使用人工智能。生成图像和视频。它包括一个“辣味模式”来创建色情内容。

在短短几天内，Grok Imagine 就被用来生成至少 180 万张女性性感图像和至少 65 张儿童性感图像，这些图像出现在 SpaceX 旗下的 X 平台上。儿童性虐待图像在世界上大多数地区都是非法的，美国法律禁止未经成人同意发布成人的亲密图像。

弗吉尼亚州总检察长杰·琼斯在一份新闻稿中表示，Grok Imagine 的“辣味模式”“特别允许创作裸体和其他性感图像”。该公司推广该产品之际，Grok 落后于 A.I.据各州称，OpenAI、Anthropic 和 SpaceX 等公司创建的模型并没有阻止其工具被用来制造这种材料。

俄勒冈州总检察长丹·雷菲尔德 (Dan Rayfield) 在谈到 SpaceX 时表示，像 Grok Imagine 这样的工具“让他们的人工智能模型变得有意义。这将使他们在未来赚得盆满钵满。” “我们不希望我们的技术创造出未经同意的图像，特别是我们孩子的图像。”

这两起诉讼都寻求经济损失。

X 在周一的一份声明中表示，使用其产品生成未成年人性图像或未经同意的真人露骨图像的人故意违反了其服务条款。该公司表示，此后已加强保护并向执法部门举报违规者。

X 用户促使 Grok Imagine 在 12 月和 1 月创作了大量色情图片。在引起公众强烈抗议和监管机构调查后，X 表示将不再允许用户公开发布色情图片。

SpaceX 在 5 月份的一份监管文件中表示，Grok 生成色情内容的能力给投资者带来了风险。今年，xAI，人工智能。 SpaceX 旗下的公司起诉了几名使用聊天机器人制作儿童性虐待材料的 Grok 用户，称他们滥用了这项技术。

雷菲尔德和琼斯将他们的诉讼比作最近针对 Meta 的州诉讼，后者指控这家社交媒体公司利用令人上瘾的平台危害儿童。 8 月，Meta 同意与 47 个州、哥伦比亚特区和美国领土就索赔达成 171 亿美元的和解，并表示将对其产品进行重大改变。

“我们将投入所有资源、精力、时间和力量来追究这些大公司的责任，”琼斯在接受采访时表示。 “人们的安全取决于此，我们不会再让这些公司对人们进行粗暴对待。”

news.title: US spies tracked Nvidia scandal figure's ties to Chinese intelligence for over a year
news.title_en: US spies tracked Nvidia scandal figure's ties to Chinese intelligence for over a year
news.author: Maximilian Schreiner
news.article_content:
The woman at the center of the Nvidia scandal was in contact with China's top spy agency for over a year, US intelligence reports show. Alice Huang communicated with China's Ministry of State Security from spring 2025 through this fall, according to the New York Times, citing US intelligence findings. The entire time, she was carrying on a secret affair with then-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.

US spy agencies had been tracking the contacts for more than a year. Alice Huang's business partner Kang Wei, whom she introduced to acquaintances as her husband, is also believed to have cooperated with the ministry. Federal investigators are now trying to determine whether the two used a web of companies across Southeast Asia to funnel Nvidia AI chips into China, skirting US export controls. Alice Huang's firm Megaspeed is part of that network.

Jensen Huang resigned as CEO earlier this month after the affair became public, along with reports of a second relationship. President Donald Trump tried to downplay the allegations and floated the idea of Huang returning to the company. Nvidia's board shut that down.

Meanwhile, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told Nvidia to come clean about its chip sales to China before the company makes any decisions about its future leadership. Jensen Huang is set to testify behind closed doors before the US House of Representatives on December 1.

news.article_content_zh:
美国情报报告显示，英伟达丑闻中心的这名女性与中国最高间谍机构接触了一年多。据《纽约时报》援引美国情报调查结果报道，从 2025 年春季到今年秋季，黄爱丽与中国国家安全部进行了沟通。整个过程中，她一直在与时任英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋保持秘密关系。

美国间谍机构追踪这些接触者已经一年多了。黄爱丽的商业伙伴康伟（她向熟人介绍为她的丈夫）也被认为与该部门合作。联邦调查人员目前正试图确定两人是否利用遍布东南亚的公司网络将英伟达人工智能芯片输送到中国，从而规避美国的出口管制。 Alice Huang 的公司 Megaspeed 是该网络的一部分。

本月早些时候，黄仁勋在这段恋情曝光以及有关第二段恋情的报道后辞去了首席执行官一职。唐纳德·特朗普总统试图淡化这些指控，并提出让黄重返公司的想法。英伟达董事会关闭了该计划。

与此同时，财政部长斯科特·贝森特 (Scott Bessent) 要求英伟达在就其未来的领导地位做出任何决定之前，先坦白其对中国的芯片销售情况。黄仁勋将于 12 月 1 日在美国众议院闭门作证。

news.title: Nvidia Is Powering Brain-Computer Interfaces Now
news.title_en: Nvidia Is Powering Brain-Computer Interfaces Now
news.author: Emily Mullin
news.article_content:
A Michigan woman named Mary has a chip in her brain roughly the size of a dime. Though she struggles to speak due to motor neuron disease, the implant allows her to express her thoughts through a synthesized voice on a computer.

Made by brain-computer interface company Paradromics, the implant is outwardly invisible, but the speech decoding requires a cart full of electronics. A year from now, however, that cart will be transformed into a small box that can sit on her wheelchair, thanks to technology from Nvidia. Eventually, those electronics will be so small they’ll fit in a phone, says Paradromics CEO and founder Matt Angle.

Today, Austin-based Paradromics announced a partnership with the AI chipmaker to use Nvidia’s hardware and software to process its brain data. Nvidia is facing a major leadership shakeup and federal scrutiny following longtime CEO Jensen Huang’s resignation over an affair with an alleged Chinese spy.

Though Mary has lost much of the use of her speaking muscles, neurons in her brain still fire when she attempts to speak. The Paradromics implant uses more than 400 embedded electrodes to capture those signals, and a computer uses artificial intelligence to make inferences about what she’s trying to say. The words appear on a screen, and the computer speaks the words for her.

That decoding process takes an incredible amount of computing power. The cart of electronics has to be plugged into an electrical outlet, and Mary must be within range of the cart in order to use her brain-computer interface.

“We're producing a huge amount of data that has a lot of value, but we need to translate that neural data into applications in order to make this a really effective platform,” Angle says. It’s why he calls brain-computer interfaces the ultimate case for edge computing, a distributed computing model that processes and stores data in physical devices close to where it is generated rather than sending it to a distant cloud or data center.

“We want to be able to do it through increasingly smaller and lower-power devices, and the people leading in that area are Nvidia,” he says.

Making brain-computer interfaces practical and portable for patients is a major challenge for the field. While these setups have become far more streamlined since their early days in academic labs, they still require lots of external electronics. Shrinking them down and reducing their power requirements would allow patients to be more mobile with these devices, using them wherever they go.

Paradromics plans to do that by using Nvidia’s Jetson, a low-powered computing module that will allow speech decoding to be done in a small device close to the user. It will also use Holoscan, Nvidia’s AI sensor processing software, to allow users to interact with computers and other devices with low lag time. Brain-computer interfaces will need to work alongside other sensors, such as cameras and microphones, and Holoscan will help process these different data streams together so applications can respond to both neural signals and the context around them.

“Brain-computer interfaces must translate complex neural signals into meaningful actions in real time. Even small delays can make communication feel unnatural,” David Niewolny, Nvidia’s director of business development for health care and medical, tells WIRED via email. “Neural signals also change over time, requiring AI that can continuously adapt to the individual.” Nvidia’s technology processes neural signals and runs AI models in real time.

Reducing lag time is important for a brain-computer interface with a speech function so that users can have naturally flowing conversation without delays.

Through the partnership, Paradromics will also be able to integrate Nvidia’s foundation models into its brain-computer interface. Vikash Gilja, chief scientific officer at Paradromics, says AI models could help make synthesized voices more expressive and human-like. Also, if these models are running locally on Nvidia hardware, it means users won’t have to be connected to the internet in order to use their devices.

Niewolny says he sees “tremendous potential for AI to expand human capability.” Nvidia is working with other players in the brain-computer interface space, including Synchron. The chipmaker will not have access to brain data through these partnerships, he says.

news.title_zh: Paradromics联手英伟达推进脑机接口边缘计算
news.summary_zh: 脑机接口公司Paradromics与英伟达达成合作，利用其边缘计算技术将脑机信号处理设备小型化
news.article_content_zh:
密歇根州一位名叫玛丽的妇女的大脑中有一个大约一毛钱大小的芯片。尽管她因运动神经元疾病而难以说话，但植入物使她能够通过计算机上的合成声音表达自己的想法。

该植入物由脑机接口公司 Paradromics 制造，从表面上看是隐形的，但语音解码需要一辆装满电子设备的推车。然而，一年后，借助 Nvidia 的技术，那辆手推车将变成一个可以坐在她轮椅上的小盒子。 Paradromics 首席执行官兼创始人马特·安格 (Matt Angle) 表示，最终，这些电子产品将变得非常小，可以装入手机中。

今天，总部位于奥斯汀的 Paradromics 宣布与这家人工智能芯片制造商合作，使用 Nvidia 的硬件和软件来处理其大脑数据。在长期担任首席执行官的黄仁勋因涉嫌与中国间谍有染而辞职后，英伟达正面临重大领导层改组和联邦审查。

尽管玛丽已经失去了大部分说话肌肉的使用能力，但当她试图说话时，她大脑中的神经元仍然会放电。 Paradromics 植入物使用 400 多个嵌入式电极来捕获这些信号，计算机使用人工智能来推断她想说的话。这些话出现在屏幕上，电脑为她说出这些话。

该解码过程需要令人难以置信的计算能力。电子产品推车必须插入电源插座，并且玛丽必须在推车的范围内才能使用她的脑机接口。

“我们正在生成大量具有很大价值的数据，但我们需要将这些神经数据转化为应用程序，以便使其成为一个真正有效的平台，”安格尔说。这就是为什么他将脑机接口称为边缘计算的终极案例，边缘计算是一种分布式计算模型，可以在靠近数据生成位置的物理设备中处理和存储数据，而不是将其发送到遥远的云或数据中心。

“我们希望能够通过越来越小、功耗越来越低的设备来实现这一目标，而在这一领域处于领先地位的是英伟达，”他说。

使脑机接口对患者实用且便携是该领域的主要挑战。虽然这些设置自学术实验室早期以来已经变得更加简化，但它们仍然需要大量外部电子设备。缩小它们的尺寸并降低其电力需求将使患者能够更加灵活地使用这些设备，无论他们走到哪里都可以使用它们。

Paradromics 计划通过使用 Nvidia 的 Jetson 来实现这一目标，Jetson 是一种低功率计算模块，可以在靠近用户的小型设备中完成语音解码。它还将使用 Nvidia 的 AI 传感器处理软件 Holoscan，让用户能够以低延迟时间与计算机和其他设备进行交互。脑机接口需要与其他传感器（例如摄像头和麦克风）一起工作，而 Holoscan 将帮助一起处理这些不同的数据流，以便应用程序能够响应神经信号及其周围的环境。

“脑机接口必须将复杂的神经信号实时转化为有意义的动作。即使是很小的延迟也会让沟通感觉不自然，”Nvidia 医疗保健和医疗业务发展总监 David Niewolny 通过电子邮件告诉《连线》杂志。 “神经信号也会随着时间的推移而变化，需要人工智能能够不断适应个体。” Nvidia 的技术可以处理神经信号并实时运行人工智能模型。

减少延迟时间对于具有语音功能的脑机接口来说非常重要，这样用户就可以进行自然流畅的对话而不会出现延迟。

通过此次合作，Paradromics 还将能够将 Nvidia 的基础模型集成到其脑机接口中。 Paradromics 首席科学官 Vikash Gilja 表示，人工智能模型可以帮助使合成声音更具表现力、更接近人类。此外，如果这些模型在 Nvidia 硬件上本地运行，则意味着用户无需连接到互联网即可使用其设备。

尼沃尔尼表示，他看到了“人工智能在扩展人类能力方面的巨大潜力”。 Nvidia 正在与脑机接口领域的其他参与者合作，其中包括 Synchron。他说，芯片制造商将无法通过这些合作伙伴关系获取大脑数据。

Haas, 64, will also take on a role as vice chairman of SoftBank Group Corp., Arm's largest shareholder, starting on Dec. 1, the company said in a statement on Monday.

"I've never been more confident about Arm's future," Haas said in the statement. "I'm incredibly proud of what we're building and wholly committed to realizing Arm's full potential for many years to come."

Executive recruiting firm Heidrick & Struggles, appointed by Nvidia's board to find a successor to Huang after the chipmakers longtime CEO and co-founder was ousted, had approached Haas, who was seen as a leading contender for the job. Haas had previously served for seven years at Nvidia as general manager of computing products. Nvidia also attempted to acquire Arm in 2020, though the merger eventually broke down in the face of regulatory opposition.

news.title: GPT-6.2 Astra solved a math theorem no other AI could crack, then invented its own proof strategy
news.title_en: GPT-6.2 Astra solved a math theorem no other AI could crack, then invented its own proof strategy

inline_images.caption: GPT-6.2 Astra built its proof around "capacity,"a metric that behaves like the edge of a graph. | Image: Vals AI
inline_images.caption_en: GPT-6.2 Astra built its proof around "capacity,"a metric that behaves like the edge of a graph. | Image: Vals AI

news.author: Manuel Uth
news.article_content:
OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra produced a formalized, machine-verifiable proof of a 2006 theorem with zero human help during the run. According to Vals AI, it's the first known proof of Smoktunowicz's gap theorem written in Lean. The theorem states that when a mathematical system multiplies its basic building blocks, growth is either quite slow or very fast. There's no middle ground. Because key foundations of the original proof were missing from the math library Mathlib, Astra took a different route than the published mathematical proofs, Vals says. It used "capacity,"a metric from existing research that checks the minimum number of elements added per computation step.

This happened on Autoform-Hard, a subset of Meta FAIR's AutoformBench curated by Vals. It contains 56 tasks (five corrected) that ten models in Meta's study failed to solve within budget. When Astra tried to quit after 47 minutes and eight dollars, the system rejected the attempt since unsolved submissions aren't accepted until $20 has been spent. After nine minutes of silence with no code input while it searched for a new strategy, Astra delivered the 1,800-line proof at the 94-minute mark for $21.58. It now leads the leaderboard with 49 solved tasks, ahead of GPT-6.2 Sol and Claude Fable 5.2 at 48 each.

news.summary_en: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra model successfully generated a machine-verifiable proof for the Smoktunowicz gap theorem on the Autoform-Hard benchmark, overcoming missing mathematical foundations in the library. By autonomously selecting a new research-based proof strategy, the model produced 1,800 lines of Lean code, signaling a transition from heuristic searching to creative proof generation in AI reasoning.
news.article_content_en:
OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra produced a formalized, machine-verifiable proof of a 2006 theorem with zero human help during the run. According to Vals AI, it's the first known proof of Smoktunowicz's gap theorem written in Lean. The theorem states that when a mathematical system multiplies its basic building blocks, growth is either quite slow or very fast. There's no middle ground. Because key foundations of the original proof were missing from the math library Mathlib, Astra took a different route than the published mathematical proofs, Vals says. It used "capacity,"a metric from existing research that checks the minimum number of elements added per computation step.

This happened on Autoform-Hard, a subset of Meta FAIR's AutoformBench curated by Vals. It contains 56 tasks (five corrected) that ten models in Meta's study failed to solve within budget. When Astra tried to quit after 47 minutes and eight dollars, the system rejected the attempt since unsolved submissions aren't accepted until $20 has been spent. After nine minutes of silence with no code input while it searched for a new strategy, Astra delivered the 1,800-line proof at the 94-minute mark for $21.58. It now leads the leaderboard with 49 solved tasks, ahead of GPT-6.2 Sol and Claude Fable 5.2 at 48 each.

news.article_content_zh:
OpenAI 的 GPT-6.2 Astra 在运行过程中无需人工帮助，就 2006 年定理生成了形式化的、可机器验证的证明。根据 Vals AI 的说法，这是用 Lean 编写的 Smoktunowicz 间隙定理的第一个已知证明。该定理指出，当一个数学系统将其基本构建模块相乘时，增长要么非常慢，要么非常快。没有中间立场。瓦尔斯说，由于数学库 Mathlib 中缺少原始证明的关键基础，因此 Astra 采用了与已发布的数学证明不同的路线。它使用了“容量”，这是现有研究中的一个指标，用于检查每个计算步骤添加的最小元素数量。

这发生在 Autoform-Hard 上，它是 Vals 策划的 Meta FAIR AutoformBench 的一个子集。它包含 56 项任务（其中 5 项已修正），Meta 研究中的 10 个模型未能在预算内解决这些任务。当 Astra 在 47 分钟和 8 美元后尝试退出时，系统拒绝了该尝试，因为只有花费 20 美元后才会接受未解决的提交。在搜索新策略的过程中，在没有任何代码输入的沉默九分钟之后，Astra 在 94 分钟内以 21.58 美元的价格交付了 1,800 行的证明。目前，它以 49 项已解决的任务领先于排行榜，领先于 GPT-6.2 Sol 和 Claude Fable 5.2（各 48 项）。

news.title: Marlowe Raises $277 Million to Bolster Alternatives to Nvidia Chips
news.title_en: Marlowe Raises $277 Million to Bolster Alternatives to Nvidia Chips
news.author: Bloomberg
news.article_content:
Key Points Marlowe bets that co-designing chips facilities and software for specific inference…View moreMarlowe bets that co-designing chips facilities and software for specific inference workloads beats general-purpose clusters.The startup targets NVIDIA's integrated model by arguing no single system serves every workload efficiently.Marlowe projects compounding gains in networking power and fleet operations could yield a 2–3x advantage. Marlowe announced on November 23, 2026 that it had raised $277 million in seed funding and detailed its plan to build and operate AI factories designed for inference workloads across multiple types of chips.

The institutional investors named include Accel, Bessemer, Altimeter, Atreides and Eclipse, alongside other venture firms and angel investors. Dan Lewis and Kutta Srinivasan founded Marlowe in May 2026 in collaboration with Lior Susan, Ido Susan and Chris Ré. Lewis is chief executive and Srinivasan is chief technology officer.

Marlowe says inference usage is growing faster than supply, increasing costs and throttling use. Existing clusters are not optimized for inference, while financing, construction, permitting, regulation and power constraints are making new capacity harder to bring online. Data-center construction costs have risen 40% since 2020, intensifying the focus on getting more output from available power.

Marlowe positions its approach against the NVIDIA-centered AI factory, which integrated GPUs, CPUs, networking and software as the industry built larger training clusters. Its strategy addresses two limitations of general-purpose infrastructure: a single system cannot serve every training and inference workload efficiently, and dependence on one chipmaker concentrates supply-chain risk.

AMD, Amazon, Arm, Broadcom, Cerebras, Etched, Google and Meta are among the companies Marlowe identifies as developing chips intended to reduce inference costs or improve performance. Its premise is that a chip alone cannot produce tokens; facilities, networking and software are necessary for new silicon to reach its design potential.

Marlowe plans to design, build and operate compute for specific inference workloads rather than supply identical configurations for every customer. Its variables include response time, CPU-to-GPU ratio, model size and architecture, input-to-output ratio, security and price sensitivity. A coding agent, a voice assistant that must respond in under a second and long-document analysis therefore present different infrastructure requirements.

Marlowe says optimizing data-center and inference layers independently can strand power and underutilize compute. Its alternative is to co-design the stack for each major workload class. The published design extends from chip selection and facility design to the software that manages servers, executes models and routes tokens.

The company projects that gains in networking, power management, AI-driven fleet operations and workload-specific inference optimization can compound into a 2–3x overall advantage in performance, availability, resiliency and cost. Its operating measures are tokens per watt, tokens per dollar and GPU uptime, tying that objective to energy use, customer economics and utilization.

Marlowe expects its first site to go live in December 2026 as it develops sites and works with several chipmakers. AMD senior vice president of AI Vamsi Boppana said AMD expects to deploy its Helios system with Marlowe in 2027, and highlighted Marlowe’s contributions to AMD’s software ecosystem.

Etched co-founder and president Rob Wachen said Etched expects to deploy its first inference clusters with Marlowe during 2026. Marlowe’s team also embeds with AI application companies to optimize their workloads for alternative silicon. Its target customers are AI application and platform companies seeking greater compute capacity at lower cost, and the company is hiring in data-center engineering, infrastructure software and hardware-software co-design.

Those deployments will test whether Marlowe’s coordinated design can make alternative silicon practical for customers while delivering the efficiency gains it has projected.

news.article_content_zh:
Marlowe 是一家新成立的人工智能计算公司，已获得 2.77 亿美元的资金，用于开发利用 AMD 加速器作为 Nvidia 芯片替代品的基础设施。此举被视为挑战英伟达在人工智能硬件市场主导地位的战略举措。 Marlowe 计划在 2026 年底前建立其第一个数据中心。这一进展是在半导体行业竞争加剧的背景下进行的，特别是在人工智能领域，英伟达传统上在该领域占据着重要的市场份额。

英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋等主要参与者和行业竞争对手可能会对这种新的竞争做出战略性反应。市场将关注 Marlowe 基础设施项目的进一步发展以及 AMD 市场定位的任何变化。此外，英伟达即将发布的财务报告以及微软和亚马逊等大公司对人工智能资本支出指导的任何变化都可能进一步影响市场对英伟达股票表现的信心。

Its variables include response time, CPU-to-GPU ratio, model size and architecture, input-to-output ratio, security and price sensitivity. A coding agent, a voice assistant that must respond in under a second and long-document analysis therefore present different infrastructure requirements.

Marlowe says optimizing data-center and inference layers independently can strand power and underutilize compute. Its alternative is to co-design the stack for each major workload class. The published design extends from chip selection and facility design to the software that manages servers, executes models and routes tokens.

The company projects that gains in networking, power management, AI-driven fleet operations and workload-specific inference optimization can compound into a 2–3x overall advantage in performance, availability, resiliency and cost. Its operating measures are tokens per watt, tokens per dollar and GPU uptime, tying that objective to energy use, customer economics and utilization.

Marlowe expects its first site to go live in December 2026 as it develops sites and works with several chipmakers. AMD senior vice president of AI Vamsi Boppana said AMD expects to deploy its Helios system with Marlowe in 2027, and highlighted Marlowe’s contributions to AMD’s software ecosystem.

Etched co-founder and president Rob Wachen said Etched expects to deploy its first inference clusters with Marlowe during 2026. Marlowe’s team also embeds with AI application companies to optimize their workloads for alternative silicon. Its target customers are AI application and platform companies seeking greater compute capacity at lower cost, and the company is hiring in data-center engineering, infrastructure software and hardware-software co-design.
Those deployments will test whether Marlowe’s coordinated design can make alternative silicon practical for customers while delivering the efficiency gains it has projected.

news.title: Bret Taylor’s Sierra Finalizing More Than $1.75 Billion Round
news.title_en: Bret Taylor’s Sierra Finalizing More Than $1.75 Billion Round
news.author: Ivan Mehta
news.article_content:
Enterprise customer experience company Sierra, co-founded by former Salesforce co-CEO Bret Taylor, said on Monday that it has raised $1.75 billion in a Series F round that doubles the company’s valuation to $30 billion. The new raise comes within six months of its previous round, which valued the company at $15 billion.

The new round was led by Greenoaks and Lightspeed Venture Partners, with participation from existing investors who have led previous rounds, including Benchmark, Sequoia, Greenoaks, GV, and Tiger Global.

Enterprise automation is among the few areas where AI has seen rapid adoption. Sierra said that it currently serves almost 50% of Fortune 50 companies, and its clients include BNY, HSBC, Singtel, Wells Fargo, JPMorganChase, Pearson, Next, and Cox Automotive. The company late last month said its outcome-based pricing model has helped it double its run-rate revenue to $400 million within five months.

That said, Sierra is working along similar lines as other customer experience players in the market, which is creating a platform to build agents and partner with model developers to provide choices to enterprises. As personal and work agents interact with enterprise systems, Sierra is also working on creating protocol definitions for agents with companies like Meta, Stripe, and Walmart.

Sierra will use the fresh cash build to its technology stack to layer agents for servicing, and hire more sales folks to sign and maintain enterprise contracts faster than its rivals.

Startups operating in the CX space have seen multi-million-dollar rounds come their way with soaring valuations. Voice AI company ElevenLabs is now valued at $22 billion; Decagon is valued at $4.5 billion; Wonderful is valued at $5 billion; and Parloa is valued at $3 billion. Multiple other startups have scored investments of more than $100 million.

During the HumanX conference in Amsterdam in September, Sierra co-founder Clay Bavor argued that despite the popular belief that AI-powered CX companies are replacing humans in contact centers, a majority of its customers are reassigning roles to existing employees.

news.title: Submit Your Questions: Will Anyone Keep You Safe From AI?
news.title_en: Submit Your Questions: Will Anyone Keep You Safe From AI?
news.author: Sandra Upson, Steven Levy, and Lauren Goode
news.article_content:
The AI safety conversation, as Lauren Goode put it, has lost the plot. Will the technology really kill us all? Should each one of us be worried about cyberattacks by rogue agents? Will it bring on total societal collapse? Though there’s room for disagreement about which catastrophe is most salient, experts are aligned on the idea that society is, for one reason or another, in real trouble. This begs one big question: What are industry leaders doing to mitigate the danger they’ve unleashed? Though a pause in training models, a data center moratorium, and other regulation has been proposed, the industry hasn’t exactly made changes that are putting people at ease around AI safety. Meanwhile, critical infrastructure seems more and more vulnerable every day. We’re gathering our Backchannel team, who will deploy their expertise on the ins and outs of Big Tech and AI safety, to answer all your questions.

Bring all your questions about Big Tech and AI safety to WIRED’s next, subscriber-only livestream scheduled for December 2 at noon ET / 9am PT. To leave questions in advance, head to the comment section below.

For more stories on AI safety, check out our ongoing series where we assess the real threats of AI.

In the meantime, check out past livestreams on women in tech, the defense tech industry, and the future of electric vehicles.
